risk_description: Offline-first synchronization complexity using 'last-write-wins' strategy with Isar DB may lead to data inconsistencies, ghost data, or overwriting user progress during multi-device usage scenarios.
root_cause: Inherently complex logic required to map local Isar schemas to backend SQL relations while managing 'dirty' states, conflict resolution, and network interruptions.
mitigation_strategy: Implement a rigorous 'Sync Queue' pattern on the client; Develop comprehensive integration tests simulating poor network conditions; Use high-resolution UTC timestamps for conflict resolution.
contingency_plan: Fallback to a 'Server-Authority' model where the client forces a re-fetch upon conflict detection, notifying the user of potential data reset.
monitoring_trigger: Client-side error logs (Sentry) indicating sync failures > 2% or user reports of data regression.

risk_description: Mobile App Store rejection (Apple/Google) due to In-App Purchase (IAP) implementation, privacy compliance (ATT framework), or account deletion (GDPR) requirements violations.
root_cause: Strict and frequently changing App Store Review Guidelines regarding digital goods, data collection transparency, and user rights.
mitigation_strategy: Submit to TestFlight/Internal Tracks early in development (pre-alpha); rigorously adhere to Human Interface Guidelines; implement 'Restore Purchases' logic immediately.
contingency_plan: Allocate 2-week buffer in release timeline for review rejection remediation; Prepare toggle to disable IAP features remotely if blocking critical bug fixes.
monitoring_trigger: Rejection notice from App Store Review or flagging of binary during upload processing.

risk_description: Aurora Serverless v2 and OpenSearch Serverless cost overruns due to inefficient auto-scaling configuration or unoptimized queries during development and initial load testing.
root_cause: Serverless pay-per-use models can spike unpredictably with unoptimized EF Core queries (N+1) or excessive polling from the mobile client.
mitigation_strategy: Set strict AWS Budget alerts; Implement maximum ACU (Aurora Capacity Unit) caps in CDK; Enable Performance Insights to identify heavy queries early.
contingency_plan: Migrate to provisioned instances for predictable billing if serverless costs exceed budget by 20% for two consecutive months.
monitoring_trigger: AWS Cost Explorer forecast exceeding monthly budget threshold ($500/mo dev, $2000/mo prod).

risk_description: Mobile background timer reliability issues on iOS/Android due to aggressive OS battery optimization killing the application process while the timer is running.
root_cause: Mobile operating systems suspend background threads to save battery, making real-time counters unreliable without foreground services.
mitigation_strategy: Rely exclusively on storing `start_time` timestamp in Isar DB and calculating elapsed time on resume, rather than keeping a thread alive.
contingency_plan: Implement 'Screen On' wake lock during reading sessions (optional user setting) to prevent app suspension.
monitoring_trigger: QA reports of timer discrepancies between actual elapsed time and recorded session time.

risk_description: Context switching fatigue and skill gaps within the team due to the requirement of mastering three distinct languages (C#, Dart, TypeScript) and ecosystems.
root_cause: The project uses a polyglot stack (Full Stack .NET/Flutter + DevOps CDK) requiring broad expertise rather than specialization.
mitigation_strategy: Establish strict code review pairs (e.g., Backend specialist reviews Mobile API calls); Create shared 'Contract' definitions (Swagger/OpenAPI) to decouple development.
contingency_plan: Contract external specialist for specific high-complexity components (e.g., a dedicated Flutter developer for UI polish).
monitoring_trigger: Velocity slowdown (burndown chart flattening) or high defect density in cross-stack integration points.

risk_description: Google Books API throttling or service degradation impacting the core 'Add Book' functionality, leading to user inability to populate libraries.
root_cause: Dependency on a third-party public API with rate limits and no SLA guarantee.
mitigation_strategy: Implement backend proxy with aggressive caching (Redis) and Polly Circuit Breaker pattern; Implement 'Manual Entry' feature as a robust fallback.
contingency_plan: Switch metadata provider to Open Library API if Google Books becomes unreliable or restrictively rated.
monitoring_trigger: Backend logs showing 429 Too Many Requests or 5xx errors from the Google Books proxy > 1% of requests.
